name: Conciergerie express
pitch: Conciergerie express is a concierge service in the Île-de-France region: dry cleaning, shoe repair, parcel collection, small errands. A courier picks up and brings back the items at home or at the office, in a slot booked in the app. The subscription costs €19 a month and includes four visits; each extra visit costs €6. The service covers Paris and the inner suburbs. Turnaround times depend on the providers (dry cleaning: 48 to 72 hours).
targetAudience: Professionals aged 25 to 35 in the Paris region, with no time for small chores.
businessModel: Monthly subscription at €19 (4 visits included), extra visits at €6.
alternatives: Parcel pickup points near the office

target.eligibility: age >= 25 and age <= 35 and region == IDF and pcs == 3 and activity_status == employed
